purpose: Model-facing context-usage note and placement transform shared by server tool loop, request preview and token view; plus the client carriage of the resolved window and model family.

public_api.name: buildContextUsageNote
public_api.signature: ({ usedTokens?: number; windowTokens: number; source: ContextNoteSource }) => string
public_api.description: Fixed en-US text; uses contextPercent; no numbers without usedTokens; assumed -> used tokens only; estimated -> approximately; always names compact_context.

public_api.name: applyContextPlacement
public_api.signature: <T extends PlacementStep>(steps: ReadonlyArray<T>, opts?: { note?: string; family?: string; placement?: ContextPlacement }) => T[]
public_api.description: Returns a new array, never mutates input. Maps compaction steps to user-role steps (collating the next user step onto them) and collates the note onto the last user step or adds a separate user step.

public_api.name: placeStepsForModel
public_api.signature: <T extends PlacementStep>(steps: ReadonlyArray<T>, input: { compactEnabled: boolean; usedTokens: number | undefined; window?: { tokens: number; source: ContextNoteSource }; family?: string }) => T[]
public_api.description: The single recipe used by tool loop and every preview; builds the note only when compactEnabled.

public_api.name: lastUsedTokens
public_api.signature: (steps: ReadonlyArray<{ usage?: { inputTokens?: number; outputTokens?: number } }>) => number | undefined
public_api.description: inputTokens + outputTokens of the last step of any kind that reports usage.

public_api.name: COMPACT_CONTEXT_TOOL_NAME
public_api.description: Tool name that gates the note.
